concerns.text: T013 is tagged [P] (parallel-safe) but its stated verification — 'following the instructions on a clean runner executes without error and produces all expected artifacts' — requires T010–T012 (experiment orchestrator, aggregation, reproducibility metrics) to be complete. The doc-writing itself is parallel-safe, but the task as specified cannot be validated in parallel with Phase 3 work; either drop the [P] tag or scope the verification to doc-content checks with pipeline execution deferred to a post-T012 gate.
